narrative: The model estimated a 68 percent probability that you would fail the bar exam on your first attempt, so your law school application was denied as a high-risk admission decision. To improve future applications, focus on the two strongest concerns: prepare thoroughly and retake the LSAT if possible, and address the third-year academic record through additional coursework or a clear explanation of circumstances. Ask admissions for feedback, strengthen your application with relevant legal or professional experience, and consider applying after you have documented improvement.
